ordering: bun run release immediately before pack; no subsequent TS build
node_libraries_section:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: "1.4.2"
      - name: Install from lock
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build and verify release packages
        # Producer restoration precedes uncached version and manifest checks.
        run: bun run release
      - name: Pack publishable workspaces
        # Only non-private workspaces with a dist build. Private internals
        # (identity, interfaces, work, services, files) and the ui lib join
        # this loop when their owners flip them public.
        run: |
          mkdir -p release-artifacts
          for w in contracts cloudflare testkit state values; do
            (cd "packages/$w" && bun pm pack >/dev/null && mv ./*.tgz "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-artifacts/")
          done
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: node-libraries
          path: release-artifacts/*.tgz
